issues.detail: The Greek 'ομοιωθηναι' (homoiōthēnai) is a passive/middle form meaning 'to be made like' or 'to be made similar to'. The Vietnamese 'làm giống như' (to act like/do like) shifts the focus from a state of being/becoming similar to an action of behaving similarly.

The Greek 'τα προς τον θεον' (ta pros ton theon) specifies 'the things [belonging] to God'. The Vietnamese 'những việc thuộc về Đức Chúa Trời' is a good rendering, but the Greek structure implies 'the things [concerning/towards] God' in the context of the priesthood.
